content.short: Spide is a community NFT project on TON focusing on unique digital collectibles and social status.
content.description: Spide is a dynamic and community-driven NFT project on the TON blockchain that emphasizes the social and status-building aspects of digital asset ownership. Centered around a collection of uniquely designed characters, Spide provides holders with a distinct digital identity within the Telegram ecosystem and access to exclusive community-led events and rewards. The project focuses on fostering a vibrant and highly engaged 'hero' culture, leveraging the speed and social integration of TON to create an interactive and rewarding experience for its passionate following of digital collectors.
content.meta: Join the Spide community on TON. Collect unique hero NFTs and earn rewards on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
